name: 記念館の使用料を区分別に設定
summary: 旧多摩聖蹟記念館の使用料の区分と金額を改めます。市内在住・在勤・在学の人などは1日1,910円、市外の人などは9,160円です。営利目的で使う場合は、それぞれ9,160円、18,320円となり、令和10年1月1日以降の利用に適用します。
changes: 市内在住者等の1日当たりの使用料を1,910円とする
市外在住者等の1日当たりの使用料を9,160円とする
営利目的の利用料を、市内在住者等は9,160円、市外在住者等は18,320円とする
第6条の第1号を削除し、残る号の番号と文言を整理する

en.name: Sets usage fees for the memorial hall by category
en.official: On the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Concerning the Former Tama Seiseki Memorial Hall
en.summary: The usage fee categories and amounts for the Former Tama Seiseki Memorial Hall will be changed. The fee will be ¥1,910 per day for people who live, work, or study in the city, etc., and ¥9,160 for people from outside the city, etc. For commercial use, the fees will be ¥9,160 and ¥18,320, respectively. These changes will apply to use on or after January 1, 2028.
changes: Set the daily fee at ¥1,910 for people who live, work, or study in the city, etc., and ¥9,160 for people from outside the city, etc.

Set commercial-use fees at ¥9,160 for people who live, work, or study in the city, etc., and ¥18,320 for people from outside the city, etc.; delete item (1) of Article 6 and revise the numbering and wording of the remaining items.
